newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans rise after Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans rise after Chicago.

text.p: Argentine cash soybeans were higher in moderate volume trade midsession at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with prices following higher values in Chicago, traders said.

The FAS elevator soybean price in Rosario rose $5 to $310. FAS elevator maize rose $2 in Bahia Blanca to $115, with the Buenos Aires playing catch up with Thursday's Chicago after markets here were closed May 1. There was good volume trade in maize, with Argentina's uncompetitive international position leading some exporters to sell. Sunflower seed rose $8 in Buenos Aires to $228 in tight trade, on higher oil prices.
